name: OmaSDR
author: marv
description: Listen to FM radio through an SDR++ server.

barWidget.description: Tune stereo broadcast FM from an SDR++ native server and listen through the desktop's default audio output.

schema.label: SDR++ server (host:port)
schema.description: Address of the SDR++ native server. Port 5259 by default.

schema.label: Starting FM frequency (MHz)
schema.description: Frequency the panel opens on. Broadcast FM only.

schema.label: Starting volume (0–1)
schema.description: Radio volume only; the desktop's own output volume is untouched.
